overview_description.description:
Apptio is the leading provider of cloud-based Technology Business Management (TBM) software that helps CIOs manage the business of IT.

Apptio’s suite of applications use business analytics to provide facts and insights about technology cost, value, and quality, so IT leaders can make faster, data-driven decisions. The purpose-built applications help companies align technology spend to business outcomes and automate IT processes like cost transparency, benchmarking, showback/chargeback, operational efficiency, and planning. Powering Apptio’s applications is a next generation, in-memory cost analytics platform that takes data directly from all financial, operational, and billing systems, and powers applications that give customers deep insight.

product.name: IBM Apptio Costing
product.description: A tool that provides transparency into technology costs and their impact, helping organizations understand key spend drivers linked to business priorities.

product.name: IBM Apptio Planning
product.description: A solution that streamlines technology budgeting and forecasting, offering variance analysis and scenario planning to support continuous planning.

product.name: IBM Apptio Billing
product.description: An automated cost recovery solution that communicates IT value, enables business partnership, and empowers stakeholders to understand technology consumption.

product.name: IBM Apptio Benchmarking
product.description: A self-service tool for comparing technology spending against peers over time to track performance, validate decisions, and identify improvement areas.

product.name: IBM Cloudability
product.description: A cloud financial management platform that ingests and structures cloud billing and usage data to manage spend and consumption across public cloud ecosystems.

product.name: Cloudability Savings Automation
product.description: A tool that automates cloud commitment programs to deliver savings without manual intervention, freeing FinOps resources.
